content:
Grouping follows FC-PI-5 application triplets in the Features section (same fiber class per row) and the documented rates: 14.025 Gb/s (16GFC, 64B/66B), 8.5 Gb/s (8GFC, 8B/10B), 4.25 Gb/s (4GFC, 8B/10B). Reach per application code comes from FC-PI-5 link-length classes referenced by those codes (as listed under compliant optical link distances). No amplified/unamplified split appears in the datasheet.
